title: HeardMuffledPayload
description: A voice the Body heard through a wall (decision 0199, MH-1): a muffled notice with a compass direction and a distance band, as heard_sound gives them. The plugin sends it on geldar.<shard>.body.<life_id>.hearing. It never carries coordinates, a speaker or words, and it does not wake the Mind. The schema rejects x, y, z and every other field.

direction.description: World-fixed direction of the voice: n is -z, s is +z, e is +x, w is -x.

band.description: Distance band of the voice, as heard_sound: near up to 8 blocks, mid up to 16, far up to 24.
